{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders
df['is_qa'] = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99

# Check if any QA order is in the loyal segment
loyal_mask = df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
qa_in_loyal = df['is_qa'] & loyal_mask

# Print details of QA orders in loyal segment
qa_loyal_rows = df[qa_in_loyal]
print("QA orders among loyal customers:")
print(qa_loyal_rows[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue', 'converted', 'is_qa']])

# Check converted status of QA loyal orders
converted_qa_loyal = qa_loyal_rows['converted'].sum()
print(f"Number of QA orders among loyal customers: {len(qa_loyal_rows)}")
print(f"Sum of 'converted' in QA loyal orders: {converted_qa_loyal}")

# Now, filter out all QA orders
df_clean = df[~df['is_qa']].copy()

# Now extract loyal customers from clean data
loyal_clean_mask = df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal'
converted_loyal_clean = df_clean[loyal_clean_mask]['converted']

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = converted_loyal_clean.mean()

# Print results
total_loyal_clean = len(converted_loyal_clean)
converted_count = converted_loyal_clean.sum()

print(f"Total loyal customers (after removing QA): {total_loyal_clean}")
print(f"Converted loyal customers: {converted_count}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")"}
